pk.context: 40 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: A retinoid for severe nodular acne whose boxed warning concerns life-threatening birth defects.

clues.text: Food raises AUC by about 50%, though it may be taken with or without meals. More than 99.9% is bound to plasma proteins, mainly albumin, and excretion is roughly equal in feces and urine.
A crystalline powder with a molecular weight of 300.44. It is practically insoluble in water but soluble in chloroform.
Capsules under an NDA, in 10, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 mg strengths; the two products have different dosage regimens.
Boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity, and contraindicated in pregnancy. Also contraindicated in hypersensitivity to it; dry lips and dry skin are the most common reactions.
Severe recalcitrant nodular acne in non-pregnant patients aged 12 and older with inflammatory nodules of 5 mm or greater, unresponsive to conventional therapy.
It inhibits sebaceous gland function and keratinization, reducing sebum secretion. The exact mechanism is unknown.
The generic name begins with I and has twelve letters.
